### Related Issues
If this PR fixes multiple issues, add each as its own bullet point preceded by `Fixes`.
- Fixes #

### Screen Recording Demo
Record and link a screen capture demoing all your changes.

### Checklist
Please make sure that the following items have been completed prior to requesting a review. **Do not check these off before actually verifying they are actually complete.**
- [ ] I have recorded and linked a screen recording above.
- [ ] Code changes in my PR have no linter warnings or errors (this applies only to the lines I made changes to, not the entire file).
- [ ] I have reviewed all my changes in a diff viewer:
  - no comments
  - no unused `use` statements
  - follows [coding standards](https://github.com/CrossBibleInc/crossbible/wiki/Coding-Standards)
- [ ] I have added logical tests to cover logic added by my PR, even if the code was already covered by other tests.
- [ ] CodeCov shows 90% test coverage for my changes.
